acceptance.description: Build xmloxide at exact commit 555055f1ea6bf9944488fd96415b6f03b5b43696 and implement its XML reference runner against the integrated protocol; record pinned Rust toolchain, compile options, enabled features and provenance.

Run the protocol known XML fixture and compare its normalized response against the integrated BCL runner; exercise invalid requests/input, offline resources and denied unconfigured external access with runner failures distinct from parse rejection.
Demonstrate task-private build scripts/runner and actual checks at known implementation revision using only integrated verified dependencies; preserve earlier behavior and validate task records.
